title: Predators, prey and the paradox of enrichment
intro: Prey grow towards the carrying capacity K of their environment; predators eat them, but each predator can only handle so many prey at a time, and predators die at a constant rate. Make the prey's environment richer by raising K and watch what happens to both populations once the first swings have died away.
kLabel: Carrying capacity of the prey, K
swingLabel: Swing of the prey (peak to peak, late in the run)
checkRich: The environment is enriched to K = 2 or more.
checkStable: The two species settle to a steady coexistence.
